race.comment: Wide open. The resuming SAVITRI (2) is of interest having last been seen running a game sixth in the G1 Australasian Oaks in Adelaide behind Panova. Prior to that she'd won two strong races in Melbourne and while 1400m is short of her best she has pace and can win, especially with a couple of dangers scratching. CASTELLITO (6) is lightly raced, winning a Class 1 fresh at Seymour before a sound effort there last time behind a handy one. Up to 1400m now should suit and she draws ideally. JENNI YOU THINK (12) is off a let up back from 1800m but has the ability to figure here, she'll be back and charging late. GEFFINA (3) resumes off a short spell and will have residual fitness, she can run well.
